title: Monotonicity transfers a bound on the monotone quantity at one centre to small balls about nearby centres (Simon 7.3.3(1), display (2))
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), points y, y' ∈ ℝ^P and reals Λ, r, τ, θ₁, θ₂, assume Λ ≥ 0, 0 < τ < r, |y' − y| < τ, θ₁·(r/(r − τ))^n ≤ θ₂, the function ρ ↦ ofReal(e^{Λρ}/ρ^n)·M_{B_ρ(y')}(T) is monotone on (0, r), and ofReal(e^{Λr}/r^n)·M_{B_r(y)}(T) ≤ ω_n·ofReal(θ₁). Then M_{B_ρ(y')}(T) ≤ ofReal(θ₂)·ω_n·ofReal(ρ^n) for every ρ with 0 < ρ < r − τ. Here M_W(T) = T.massOn W ∈ [0, ∞], ω_n = unitBallVolume n, ofReal = ENNReal.ofReal, products are in [0, ∞], and B_ρ(y) is the open ball.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (y y' : Euclid P) (Λ r τ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ), 0 ≤ Λ → 0 < τ → τ < r → dist y' y < τ → θ₁ * (r / (r - τ)) ^ n ≤ θ₂ → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y' ρ)) (Ioo 0 r) → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * r) / r ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y r) ≤ unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal θ₁ → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r - τ → T.massOn (ball y' ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ₂ * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
